title: CAB: Comprehensive Attention Benchmarking on Long Sequence Modeling
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (CAB) for evaluating efficient attention mechanisms across various tasks and attention patterns. It focuses on computational efficiency and model performance in long sequence modeling, including language modeling tasks with models like GPT-2 and RoBERTa. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics beyond general scientific research practices.
